{{Top|leg}}
A '''surveillance detector''' was a specialized [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that scanned the surrounding area to detect any type of surveillance device targeting the wielder. [[Dalabar Micro-Electronics]] produced the [[SDS-632 Surveillance Detector]].
